messages.subject: Re: Help on STAR model
parts:
Dear Eric,
The software I used is included in the R package tsDyn, which you can find
at http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tsDyn/index.html However, the STAR
implementation is still a development version, so you will have
to be careful.
The tsDyn package is a small package being developed by some volunteers. We
are always in need of help, so if you can find any way to help (correct bugs,
complete documentation etc), don't hesitate to contact the developers at the
mailing list ts...@googlegroups.com
Best regards,

--
Jos� Luis Aznarte M.
